messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing-metric-anomaly detected in eu1. Token-count delta > 3x baseline for 15m. Overflag threshold crossed for ~120 customers. Alert id=INC-1777654321 :rotating_light:
Ben (oncall): acked. I’m looking. Any obvious deploys?
Camila (billing): no deploys in billing service since 02:00 UTC, last config change 2024-06-12. I’m seeing token-emit spikes on the aggregator, but shadow counts aren't matching ledger. Examples: expected ~4.2M tokens/min, observed emitter ~13.1M, ledger ingest ~4.5M.
Marco (eng-infra): copying logs now. Could be duplicate-emits from retry loop. Can someone grab emitter-retry metrics and proxy retry-rate?
Ben (oncall): running quick check: `kubectl -n billing logs deploy/emitter -f --since=20m | grep retry`
Ben (oncall): emitter shows a lot of 5xx -> retry attempts; downstream ack latency jumped. Stacktrace shows transient redis timeout.
Zoe (prodops): redis cluster in eu1 reported a brief partial partition at 1777654250..1777654302, recovery at 1777654330. Ops note: failover completed, per-monitor.
Camila (billing): that aligns. Emitted tokens multiplied because emitter retried idempotency key not deduping on second attempts — dedupe store had increased TTL evictions during partition.
Marco (eng-infra): timeline: redis partition -> emitter retries -> duplicate emits to metering -> overflag triggers. Quick mitigation options: 1) throttle emitter retries, 2) enable fallback dedupe (local LRU), 3) temporarily mute overflag alerts to avoid customer churn while we reconcile.
Ben (oncall): putting emitter retry throttle patch into a canary patch now. `helm upgrade --set emitter.retry.maxAttempts=1 billing-emitter ./charts/billing-emitter --namespace billing --dry-run` then apply if sanity checks.
Priya (cust-success): heads-up — customers are getting overage emails. We should prepare a short message if this persists. I can draft a notice.
Camila (billing): prioritized: stop additional duplicates, then run recon to compute true ledger counts and generate credit plan. I’ll run a replay-scan to identify duplicate tokens using trace ids. Command: `python tools/recon_duplicates.py --start 1777654200 --end 1777654400 --out duplicates.csv`
Ben (oncall): can you run that Camila? I’m holding the deploy until we confirm throttle works in canary.
Camila (billing): started recon job, ETA ~6m.
Marco (eng-infra): canary applied to 10% of emitter pods at 1777654380. Retry attempts now 1. Monitoring for emitted tokens.
Ben (oncall): seeing emit rate drop in canary. Good. Rolling to 50% then 100% unless we see side-effects.
Zoe (prodops): muting automated overflag notifications to ops->customers for now to avoid duplicate emails. Set mute window 30m. Documenting in incident log.
Priya (cust-success): drafting customer note: short, apologetic, we're investigating billing signal noise caused by transient infrastructure issue; no immediate charge changes yet; we'll proactively credit if needed. Will post to status page if confirmed.
Camila (billing): recon done. Preliminary: ~2.8M duplicated tokens between start/end range (most from 1777654255-1777654335). Affected customers: 118 flagged; ledger shows ~+0.9% aggregate actual vs reported. I’ll attach duplicates.csv to the ticket.
Ben (oncall): creating ticket INC-1777654321-RECOVERY, assigning to billing + infra. Adding runbook steps: 1) ensure throttle applied cluster-wide; 2) run dedupe backfill; 3) reconcile customer flags and create credits; 4) post-mortem.
Marco (eng-infra): running backfill script now in dry-run to estimate ledger adjustment: `./bin/emit_backfill --mode=estimate --range=1777654200-1777654400`
Camila (billing): estimate mode shows net overcount ~2.6M tokens to be removed from customer charges. I'll generate credit proposal.
Priya (cust-success): if we’re crediting, recommend proactive email + optional opt-in detailed ledger export. I'll prepare templates.
Ben (oncall): ok throttle rolled to 100% at 1777654410. Monitoring shows emitter emitted tokens returned to baseline.
Zoe (prodops): unmuting customer alerts now that we have confirmation of fix and sequence for credits. We should post status (informational).
Camila (billing): started dedupe backfill (non-destructive) at 1777654430, will run scan+mark. ETA ~12m due to ledger size.
Marco (eng-infra): investigating root cause: redis eviction spikes during partition due to memory pressure + GC in sidecar. We'll raise infra task to increase dedupe store capacity + circuit-break safer retry defaults.
Ben (oncall): handoff to Alice (night-oncall) at 1777654465. Summary for handoff: incident: duplicate token emission due to redis partition -> emitter retries. Mitigations: emitter retry throttled to 1, dedupe backfill started, customer alerts drafted & credits estimated (~2.6M tokens). Ticket INC-1777654321 created, assignment: Camila + Marco + Priya. Contact list in ticket.
Alice (night-oncall): acked and taking ownership. I’ll watch backfill, confirm credits posted, and schedule post-mortem. Ping me if anything regresses. :raised_hands:
